frequency_question: How often does Congress successfully complete the passage of a joint resolution of disapproval blocking a major 123 nuclear agreement within the statutory review clock?
membership_rule: Includes all formal submitted nuclear cooperation agreements subject to congressional review periods (typically 60 or 90 continuous session days). Excludes non-binding resolutions or agreements not formally transmitted.
provenance_note: claims 25 cases from only 3 named (8.3x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: More than 20 agreements submitted historically; exactly 0 successful legislative blocks via joint resolution.
known_gaps: Exact count of minor routine amendments versus major standalone agreements varies slightly by classification, but zero successful blocks is absolute.
skeleton: Total formal 123 agreements submitted for statutory review since 1954 where a joint resolution of disapproval was introduced versus those that successfully passed both chambers and survived/overrode a veto.
multiplier: 0 successful joint resolutions of disapproval enacted into law out of more than 20 submitted formal 123 agreements.
validity_reason: The statutory framework of the Atomic Energy Act section 123 review process remains stable and unchanged.
